subject: Q3 LLM initiative — demo hold after roadmap reshuffle
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ali Rahman <ali@greenpointretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 LLM initiative — proposed demo times

Hi Ali,

Thanks again for the time on our intro last week. Per our conversation, I pulled together a short, 30-minute demo tailored to the Greenpoint fraud-detection use case (sequence-lengths and throughput notes included). I attached the tailored deck and a draft SOW for context.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue, 1 Sep — 10:00–10:30
- Wed, 2 Sep — 14:00–14:30
- Thu, 3 Sep — 09:00–09:30

If none of those work, send a few times that fit your team and we’ll accommodate. Goal of the call: walk the architecture and run a short live inference to show latency/cost characteristics on a sample workload.

Attachments: greenpoint-tailored-deck.pdf, gp-sow-v1.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
https://redwoodinference.com
From: Ali Rahman <ali@greenpointretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Q3 LLM initiative — proposed demo times

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the follow-up and the materials. Short update from our side: leadership has just gone through a roadmap re-prioritization and the LLM/inference effort is being pushed out of Q3 to focus on a payments initiative that has a higher near-term revenue impact. Our VP of Data (who would normally attend) is also traveling heavily through early September, so we won’t be able to commit to a live demo right now.

Can we put the demo on hold for the next 6–8 weeks?

That said, a couple requests to keep things moving on the side:
- Could you share a 1-page cost ballpark (hosted vs dedicated) so procurement has something to evaluate now?
- Send the demo recording or a short 7–10 minute walkthrough if you have one — that would help our product manager review asynchronously.

If anything changes sooner I’ll reach out, otherwise please check back mid-October.

Thanks,
Ali Rahman
Head of Data & Analytics | Greenpoint Retail
ali@greenpointretail.com

Hi Ali —

Totally understand — thanks for the transparency. We’ll pause scheduling for now and mark the opportunity as \"on hold\" in our pipeline.

I’ll do the following today:
- Share a concise cost ballpark for hosted vs dedicated (three bullets, pricing ranges)
- Upload a 10-minute recorded walkthrough of the demo to the Drive link below
- Keep the tailored deck and SOW available; happy to rebook a live session once your VP is back from travel

Proposed check-in cadence: I’ll reach out in ~8 weeks (mid-Oct) to see if timelines shifted. If you prefer, tell me a specific week and we’ll lock a tentative slot on a 1:1 basis.

Drive (demo + artifacts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBxyExample
HubSpot: GP-4593

Thanks again, and please let me know if you want Ben on the follow-up for technical/scale questions.

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:00:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Q3 LLM initiative — demo hold after roadmap reshuffle

Marissa / Rishi —

Noted. I set the HubSpot stage to \"On Hold\" and added a follow-up task for 2026-10-14. Action items:
- Marissa: send the 1-page pricing and the 10-min recording (if not already uploaded).
- Rishi: flag for potential Q4 expansion play (we may want to offer a short pilot discount if they re-prioritize).

Also leaving a note to capture the ask about hosted vs dedicated economics in the deal record. If anyone hears a change from Ali sooner, flag me and I’ll stand up a technical deep-dive.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
